title: Discretization and Statistical Consistency of Functional Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.04531v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Functional flow matching learns to generate random functions, such as velocity fields or solutions of partial differential equations, by continuously transforming a simple probability distribution into a target distribution. In practice, however, training and sampling use only finitely many grid values or coefficients. Does refining these observations recover the intended function-space model, and how do observation, learning, and numerical errors affect the generated distribution? We address these questions by first proving that the velocity targets used for training converge in mean square when the finite reconstructions converge to the underlying functions and remain uniformly bounded. The observations need not be nested: each refinement may replace earlier sensor locations. translated_title: 泛函流匹配的离散化与统计一致性
translated_abstract: 泛函流匹配通过将一个简单的概率分布连续变换为目标分布，学习生成随机函数，例如速度场或偏微分方程的解。然而在实践中，训练和采样仅使用有限个网格值或系数。那么，细化这些观测能否恢复预期的函数空间模型？观测误差、学习误差和数值误差又如何影响生成的分布？我们通过以下方式回答这些问题：首先证明，当有限重构收敛于底层函数并保持一致有界时，用于训练的速度目标依均方收敛。这些观测不必是嵌套的：每次细化都可以替换先前的传感器位置。我们还给出了正交投影的定量界，并在适当的正则性与重构条件下将结果推广到点观测情形。
tldr: 本文证明了在有限观测细化（允许非嵌套）且一致有界的条件下，泛函流匹配的速度目标依均方收敛，并量化了观测、学习与数值误差对生成分布的影响，为其函数空间模型的统计一致性提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the velocity targets of functional flow matching converge in mean square under refining, non-nested, uniformly bounded finite reconstructions, and quantifies how observation, learning, and numerical errors affect the generated distribution, establishing statistical consistency guarantees for the intended function-space model.
